sources.name: JMP · Safely managed drinking water services

methodology: Each country or territory uses its most recent national JMP estimate from 2000 to 2024. Where none is available, the atlas estimates coverage by multiplying local coverage of at least basic service in 2024 by the ratio of safely managed coverage to at least basic coverage in a reference group. If the national basic service figure is unavailable, the atlas uses the safely managed coverage of the group. It selects the first available reference group in this order: M49 subregion, SDG region, income group, then world. Each available national service component sets an upper bound. The atlas rounds these approximations to the nearest percentage point. The JMP provides the global figure directly.
